events.verdict: Jović's (MIA) arm is not vertical when contact occurs with Barrett's (TOR) arm, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Wiggins (MIA) appears to get his fingertips on the ball to begin the dislodge before incidental contact occurs with Dick (TOR) during the dribble.
Adebayo (MIA) aligns himself with Barnes (TOR) and marginal contact occurs before Barnes completes the pass.
Wiggins (MIA) steps forward toward Barrett (TOR) when they come together after Barrett's gather, and the contact is marginal during the shot attempt in the lane.
Quickley (TOR) turns alongside Jović (MIA) on the perimeter, which does not affect Jović's ability to pass.
Barrett (TOR) jumps toward Wiggins (MIA) when lower-body contact occurs following Wiggins' release on the three-point shot attempt.
Wiggins (MIA) and Barnes (TOR) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs.
Quickley (TOR) establishes himself with both arms in Wiggins' (MIA) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Barnes (TOR) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two legal steps before his shot attempt.
Barrett (TOR) contests the put-back attempt and marginal contact occurs with Wiggins' (MIA) arm after the release.
